training_recipe: Balanced image sampling and cross-entropy plus Tversky loss

checkpoint_selection.selection_rule: Highest recorded validation mIoU across the six final-B seeds; ties resolved by ascending seed. No area measurements used.

inference.coordinates: EXIF-oriented native pixels; remove letterbox padding before restoring logits
inference.orientation: Original UI v11 image-only orientation rule; inverse rotation for saved masks
inference.postprocessing: Argmax of fused probabilities; all non-background components retained

asset_processing.images: Byte-for-byte copies; original EXIF metadata retained.
asset_processing.masks: Byte-for-byte copies of native-resolution predicted class-label PNGs.
asset_processing.overlays: Byte-for-byte copies of display previews; foreground label colors blended at 45%, cyan line marks the 30-mm span.

package_scope: Area recalculation, descriptive statistics, figures and released prediction masks. Model weights and training/inference implementations are not included.
